test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 07 Feb 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: P, Q, and R can do a piece of work in 38 days. Q and R can do the work in 76 days. Find the number of days in which P can complete the same work.
solution:
**Given**

P, Q, R can complete the work in 38 days.

Q and R can complete the work in 76 days.

**Concept:**

If A and B together can complete a job in 'd' days and B alone can complete the same job in 'f' days, then A alone can complete the job in (d × f) / (f - d) days.

**Calculation:**

Time taken by P alone to complete the work = (38 × 76)/(76 - 38)

**Hence, P alone can complete the work in 76 days.**
